login.title: Sign in
login.description: Sign in with the username (or NIP) and password of your Sentra DCIM account.
login.rateLimited: Too many sign-in attempts. Try again in {{minutes}} minutes.
login.expired: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
login.forgot: Forgot your password or account locked? Contact your Sentra DCIM administrator.

forced.title: Change password
forced.description: Hello {{name}}, your account was just created or its password was reset.
forced.why: For security, replace this temporary password before using the application.

password.title: Change password
password.description: After the change, every other session of this account is signed out. This session stays active.
password.hint: {{min}}–{{max}} characters. A long phrase you can remember is safer than a short complex word.
password.policy: The new password must be {{min}}–{{max}} characters.
password.same: The new password must differ from the current one.
password.mismatch: The repeated new password does not match.
password.changed: Password changed. Other sessions were signed out.

sessions.title: My sessions
sessions.description: Devices currently signed in with your account. Revoke any session you do not recognise, then change your password.
sessions.note: Sessions end automatically after a period without activity or a fixed time after sign-in (column Ends at the latest). To end this session, use Sign out in the user menu.
